name: Strapi
subtitle: Open-source self-hosted headless CMS
creator: Pierre Burgy, Aurélien Georget and Jim Laurie
description: A Node.js headless CMS you run on your own server with your own database. You design content types in an admin panel and it generates REST and GraphQL APIs automatically.
useCases: Content APIs for websites and apps
Teams that must own their data

languages.youWrite: Admin panel, plus JavaScript or TypeScript for customization

codeSamples.label: Shell + HTTP
codeSamples.code:
npx create-strapi@latest my-cms   # creates the admin panel and API

# After adding an "article" content type in the admin panel:
GET https://cms.example.com/api/articles?sort=publishedAt:desc&pagination[limit]=10
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN

cons: Needs an always-on server and SQL database

pricing.summary: Community edition free to self-host. Strapi Cloud and paid self-hosted plans add hosting and features.
